title: Mac Volume Mixer: Control Each App's Volume From the Notch
desc: macOS has no per-app volume mixer. Here is what Apple's Sound settings do, how to balance audio app by app, and how Dormer puts sliders in your MacBook's notch.

title: Copy and Paste History on Mac: How to See What You Copied
desc: Your Mac keeps only the last thing you copied unless you turn history on. Here is how to see past clips, protect passwords and keep history in the notch.
cover_alt: Isometric cards suggest a retrievable clipboard history
